chapter.p: UTF-8 code points to byte sequence writer. ByteSWriter which models swriter<unsigned char> (see ) is used as a byte output.

synopsis.p: Returns reference to the used byte writer.

synopsis.prototype: template<class... Args> explicit writer(Args&&... args) C++11
synopsis.p: Forwards all parameters to the used byte writer.
Writes the specified code point according to UTF-8 encoding rules. ByteSWriter::operator() is used to write individual bytes.
Creates UTF-8 writer using specified ByteSWriter.
